setup.command: mise install && flutter pub get && (command -v java >/dev/null || sh -c 'apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && apt-get install -y -qq default-jre-headless') && (command -v firebase >/dev/null || npm install -g --silent firebase-tools)

check.command: flutter analyze && dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed . && flutter test
